cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle underlying the universe and all phenomena, often described as the source of all things and the ultimate reality.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a transcendental, unnameable, and dynamic force that governs existence.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Dao that can be spoken of is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): To express verbally or in writing.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies the act of articulating something, often used in contexts of communication or discourse.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): He spoke his words, and all heard them.|The king asked the reason, and the minister explained the cause.|I speak the king's command, daring not to conceal anything.|He described what he saw, without concealing the truth.
cards.Sentences: 道其言，人皆聞之。|君問其故，臣道所以。|臣道君命，不敢有隱。|道其所見，不隱其實。
